university: Pavol Jozef Safarik University in Kosice, Faculty of Medicine
confirmedFacts: The Faculty offers General Medicine in English; the programme lasts six years and awards MUDr.
For 2026/27, the university fee regulation sets English-language General Medicine tuition at EUR 13,000 per academic year.
Admission requires a written multiple-choice entrance examination in Biology and Chemistry; the published 2026 sitting dates are 17 June and 12 August in Kosice.
The admission page states 210 places for full-time General Medicine and identifies English as the language of instruction.
The university academic-calendar page links a 2026/27 university schedule.
